export HOME=/tmp/phase7-odom-home ROS_LOG_DIR=/tmp/phase7-odom-logs; mkdir -p "$ROS_LOG_DIR"; source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash; exec python3 -u /opt/ros2-demo/scripts/federated_odom_tf.py &
pid=$!
trap 'kill -TERM "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$pid" || true' TERM INT
while [ ! -e /phase7-shared/finished ]; do
  kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || { wait "$pid"; exit 1; }
  sleep 0.2
done
kill -TERM "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
wait "$pid" || true
containers.name: odom-tf

args:
set +e
source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash
export ROS_LOG_DIR=/tmp/phase7-verifier-logs
mkdir -p "$ROS_LOG_DIR"
python3 /opt/phase7-runtime/verify_phase7_live_nav2_cancel.py --require-live-sam3-adapter --output /phase7-shared/result.json
code=$?
touch /phase7-shared/finished
exit "$code"
